title: VIP and Super VIP 3-Day Passes are sold out
body:
VIP 3-Day, Super VIP 3-Day and VIP Glamping are all sold out for 2026, along with RV Parking and Vehicle Parking.

All sales are final and tickets are non-refundable and non-exchangeable, but sold-out ticket types can be listed for exchange through the official Front Gate exchange. GA 3-Day passes ($300) and single-day tickets are still available.

title: New for 2026: wristbands are not being mailed
body:
Wristbands will NOT be mailed this year. Every admission wristband is distributed on-site during festival week.

About a week before the festival, Front Gate will email you a digital ticket. Bring it — printed or on your phone — plus valid photo ID to the Box Office at 300 E Pacific Street.

Each ticket-holder must be present in person. You cannot collect a wristband for anyone else, including someone travelling with you.

Box Office: Thursday 10:00 AM–6:30 PM · Friday & Saturday 9:00 AM–8:15 PM · Sunday 10:00 AM–7:15 PM.

title: Saturday rare-beer session is close to selling out
body:
Saturday Session Two (4–6 PM in the Beer Garden) is the rare list: 35 or more high-ABV, barrel-aged, rare, wild and non-traditional beers. It is the smallest-capacity session of the weekend and is close to selling out.

Tasting tickets are $30–$45 and are separate from festival entry. You must be 21+ and hold a Single-Day or 3-Day festival pass in addition to the tasting ticket.

title: Gondola and shuttle hours for festival week
body:
The free Telluride–Mountain Village gondola runs extended hours this week:

• Thursday 6:30 AM – 12:00 AM
• Friday & Saturday 6:30 AM – 2:00 AM
• Sunday 6:30 AM – 12:00 AM

The free Galloping Goose shuttle runs fixed laps every 20 minutes from 7:00 AM to midnight all concert weekend, and Mountain Village shuttles run every 30 minutes. Dial-A-Ride operates 7:00 AM–12:30 AM on (970) 728-8888.

There is no festival parking lot. If Telluride is full you will be directed to Mountain Village — park at the Gondola Garage (free 6:30 AM–2:00 AM, $30 overnight) and ride in.

title: Stage 2 fire restrictions are in effect — campers read this
body:
The Telluride Fire Protection District is in Stage 2 fire restrictions. If you are camping this week:

• NO wood fires anywhere, at any time.
• Charcoal only in designated containers, and only in the Main Campground and Zone 1. Charcoal is prohibited at Warner Field — propane grills and BBQs only there.
• No camping within 50 feet of Bear Creek Falls.

Restrictions can tighten at short notice. Check the San Miguel Sheriff's Office and West Slope Fire Information for the current status before you light anything.
